title: Estimated effort for three improvement options
method: Synthetic planning estimates. Bars compare implementation effort only. Benefits differ in kind: attribution, manual effort and response speed. No cost saving or maturity ranking is inferred from these values.
alt: Estimated effort for three improvement options. Resolve owner mapping: 20 engineering hours; Automate forecast report: 40 engineering hours; Faster anomaly pipeline: 100 engineering hours. Illustrative values.
